name: Flydigi Vader 4
author: z23
description: Set the light bar on a Flydigi Vader 4 Pro from the Omarchy bar: solid colors, the factory stream effect, brightness, and an option to follow the theme accent.

barWidget.description: Light bar color, effect, and brightness for a Flydigi Vader 4 Pro.

schema.label: Match the theme accent
schema.description: Set the light bar to the theme accent when the theme changes or the controller connects. In XInput mode the controller disconnects for a moment each time.

schema.label: Show when disconnected
schema.description: Keep the icon in the bar while no controller is connected.
